description: This file defines the class 'DefaultTransactionDataCopier<TData>' implementing the interface 'ITransactionDataCopier<TData>' within the Orleans.Transactions namespace. It provides a method for deep copying transaction data objects using a provided DeepCopier.

classes.name: DefaultTransactionDataCopier<TData>
classes.description: A class providing deep copy functionality for transaction data objects.

methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the provided transaction data object.
